title: First batch of spelling & grammar fixes
body:
Pointed an AI agent at every Markdown file in the repo modulo compiled ones (manpages targeted `.md.in` instead of `.md` and similar), and asked it to identify spelling & grammar fixes. The result is too big for a single PR, so I'm batching it into chunks that should be small enough for manual review. This is the first round of those.
